_comment: Declared on-host secret files for indri — empty until the forgejo_runner
role migrates to nix (eblume/blumeops#1213); the ansible role still
renders its runner config and writes the token files itself.
The file existing — even empty — is what the flake invariant
(darwin/indri/invariants.nix) reads, so the lockstep guard protects both
directions from the day it lands. Metadata only, no values.
